info.title: 清源 ClearTrace API
info.description: Shared data/model integration contract. Application bearer tokens and Sites gateway access are separate. Browser calls use Sites sign-in plus application membership. Responses use {data}, except CSV export and this raw OpenAPI document. Synthetic examples and rule baseline are not trained-model evaluation results. InferenceRequest/InferenceResponse describe the external server protocol, not an endpoint hosted by ClearTrace.

get.description: Requires a registered member or application token. Non-admin members receive an empty members array.

post.description: Admin/editor only. Dry run defaults to true and returns 200 with valid=false for row-level errors. A valid commit returns 201; an invalid commit returns 400 without importing. Duplicate accountId values in the batch are deduplicated. Maximum full body 5 MiB and 1000 records. Same-name imports create subsequent dataset versions.

SitesGateway.description: For a private Site, machine callers additionally need its platform-issued Bearer gateway token. Never a replacement for application authorization.
